title: pendingReward view diverges from what claim() actually pays due to stale mintDebt and uncapped-vs-balance computation
asset_impact: UX / integrator impact only. Front-ends may show a 'claimable' value that claim() cannot fulfil or that differs from the paid amount.
attack_path:
1. DEDUP-001 or a pending hook mintDebt creates divergence between stored state and post-claim state.
2. User queries pendingReward, sees value X.
3. User calls claim: reverts on shortfall OR pays a different amount than X because the view did not simulate pull() + _recomputeSchedule.
likelihood: low - UX/integrator impact, not asset impact.
assumptions: Front-end or integrator consumes pendingReward as authoritative claimable value.
justification: View function correctness issue with documented integrator consumers. Not the 'unused view' pattern (has real consumers per finding), but impact is UX / documentation. C4 Low.
